'''Hagen Kleinert''' (15 June 1941 – 7 March 2025) was a professor of theoretical physics at the Free University of Berlin, Germany.<ref name=":0" /> 

== Biography ==
Kleinert was born in [[Festenberg]] on 15 June 1941. Raised in [[Hanover]], he graduated high school in 1960 and obtained his ''[[Vordiplom]]'' with distinction from the [[Technical University of Hanover]] in 1962.<ref name=":0" />

In 1963, Kleinert moved to the United States, earning a Master of Science degree from the [[Georgia Tech|Georgia Institute of Technology]] in 1964. After studying at several intermediate institutions, he obtained his PhD from the [[University of Colorado Boulder]] in 1967 under the supervision of Asim Barut.<ref name=":0" />

He then returned to Germany and joined [[Freie Universität Berlin]], where he finished his [[habilitation]] and became an associate professor in 1969. Promoted to full professor in 1976, he worked there until retiring in 2009. He died on 7 March 2025.<ref name=":0" />

==Research==
Kleinert collaborated with [[Richard Feynman]]<ref>{{cite journal
| title = Travailler avec Feynman
| author = Kleinert H.
| journal = Pour la Science
| volume = 19
| pages = 89–95
| year = 2004
| url = http://users.physik.fu-berlin.de/~kleinert/feynman/feynmanw-Dateien/FEYNMAN_CH11_30avr.pdf
| archive-date = 26 November 2022
| access-date = 8 May 2009
| archive-url = https://web.archive.org/web/20221126192251/http://users.physik.fu-berlin.de/~kleinert/feynman/feynmanw-Dateien/FEYNMAN_CH11_30avr.pdf
}}</ref> in some of Feynman's final work, developing a method to approximate quantum-mechanical [[Partition function (statistical mechanics)|partition functions]] using classical [[Distribution function (physics)|distribution functions]].<ref>{{cite journal
| title = Effective classical partition functions
| author = [[Richard P. Feynman|Feynman R.P.]], Kleinert H.
| journal = Physical Review A
| volume = 34
| issue = 6
| pages = 5080–5084
| year = 1986
| doi = 10.1103/PhysRevA.34.5080
| url = http://www.physik.fu-berlin.de/~kleinert/159/159.pdf
| pmid = 9897894
| bibcode = 1986PhRvA..34.5080F
| archive-date = 12 March 2020
| access-date = 4 March 2008
| archive-url = https://web.archive.org/web/20200312135004/http://users.physik.fu-berlin.de/~kleinert/159/159.pdf
}}</ref><ref name=":0" /> This led to [[variational perturbation theory]], which enables a calculation of [[Critical exponent|critical exponents]]<ref>
Kleinert, H., [http://www.physik.fu-berlin.de/~kleinert/279/279.pdf "Critical exponents from seven-loop strong-coupling φ4 theory in three dimensions"]. [[Physical Review]] D 60, 085001 (1999)</ref> near second-order [[phase transition]]s. The result was later confirmed for the [[lambda point]] of helium in experiments conducted at zero gravity.<ref>{{cite journal
 |title        = Specific heat of liquid helium in zero gravity very near the lambda point
 |author       = Lipa J.A.
 |journal      = Physical Review B
 |volume       = 68
 |issue        = 17
 |article-number         = 174518
 |year         = 2003
 |doi          = 10.1103/PhysRevB.68.174518
 |url          = http://www.physik.fu-berlin.de/~kleinert/papers/lipa.pdf
 |last2        = Nissen
 |first2       = J.
 |last3        = Stricker
 |first3       = D.
 |last4        = Swanson
 |first4       = D.
 |last5        = Chui
 |first5       = T.
 |arxiv        = cond-mat/0310163
 |bibcode      = 2003PhRvB..68q4518L
 |s2cid        = 55646571
 |archive-date = 12 March 2020
 |access-date  = 4 March 2008
 |archive-url  = https://web.archive.org/web/20200312135109/http://users.physik.fu-berlin.de/~kleinert/papers/lipa.pdf
 }}</ref>

Together with [[İsmail Hakkı Duru|İsmail Duru]], Kleinert developed the [[Duru–Kleinert transformation]], an alternative to Feynman's time-sliced path integral construction, which can be used to solve the [[Path integral formulation|path integral]] formulations of the [[hydrogen]] atom and the centrifugal barrier.<ref>{{cite journal
| title = Solution of the path integral for the H-atom
| author1 = Duru I.H.
| author2 = Kleinert H.
| journal = Physics Letters B
| volume = 84
| issue = 2
| pages = 185–188
| year = 1979
| doi = 10.1016/0370-2693(79)90280-6
| url = http://www.physik.fu-berlin.de/~kleinert/kleiner_re65/65.pdf
| bibcode = 1979PhLB...84..185D
| archive-date = 9 March 2008
| access-date = 16 February 2005
| archive-url = https://web.archive.org/web/20080309160840/http://www.physik.fu-berlin.de/~kleinert/kleiner_re65/65.pdf
}}</ref><ref>{{cite journal
| title = Quantum Mechanics of H-Atom from Path Integrals
| author1 = Duru I.H.
| author2 = Kleinert H.
| journal = Fortschr. Phys.
| volume = 30
| issue = 2
| pages = 401–435
| year = 1982
| doi = 10.1002/prop.19820300802
| url = http://www.physik.fu-berlin.de/~kleinert/kleiner_re83/83.pdf
| bibcode = 1982ForPh..30..401D
| archive-date = 27 June 2007
| access-date = 16 February 2005
| archive-url = https://web.archive.org/web/20070627191646/http://www.physik.fu-berlin.de/~kleinert/kleiner_re83/83.pdf
}}</ref><ref name=":0" />

Kleinert published over 400 articles, half of which were single-author papers.<ref name=":0">{{Cite web |date=2025-08-28 |title=Obituary for Hagen Kleinert |url=https://www.physik.fu-berlin.de/en/fachbereich/nachruf/2025-hagen-kleinert.html |access-date=2026-07-22 |website=www.physik.fu-berlin.de |language=en}}</ref> The topics include [[mathematical physics]] and the [[physics]] of [[elementary particle]]s, [[Atomic nucleus|nuclei]], [[solid|solid state]] systems, [[liquid crystal]]s, [[biomembrane]]s, [[microemulsion]]s, [[polymer]]s, and the theory of [[financial markets]].<ref>{{Cite web |last=Kleinert |first=Michael |title=Homepage of Hagen Kleinert |url=http://users.physik.fu-berlin.de/~kleinert/kleinert/?p=articles&page=all |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20191206130744/http://users.physik.fu-berlin.de/~kleinert/kleinert/?p=articles&page=all |archive-date=2019-12-06 |access-date=2026-07-20 |website=users.physik.fu-berlin.de}}</ref> He also wrote several review articles and multiple monographs.<ref>{{cite journal
| title = Book Reviews
| author = Henry B.I.
| journal = Australian Physics
| volume = 44
| issue = 3
| page = 110
| year = 2007
| url = http://www.physik.fu-berlin.de/~kleinert/b5/reviews/picrithenry.doc
| archive-date = 14 April 2020
| access-date = 8 February 2008
| archive-url = https://web.archive.org/web/20200414060953/http://users.physik.fu-berlin.de/~kleinert/b5/reviews/picrithenry.doc
}}</ref> His book on path integrals has become a standard reference work.<ref name="j441">{{cite book |last=Kleinert |first=Hagen |url=https://www.worldscientific.com/worldscibooks/10.1142/5057 |title=Path Integrals in Quantum Mechanics, Statistics, Polymer Physics, and Financial Markets |date=2004 |publisher=World Scientific |isbn=978-981-238-106-4 |edition=3rd |doi=10.1142/5057 |access-date=2026-07-22}}</ref><ref name=":0" />

== Awards ==
In 2008, Kleinert received the [[Max Born Medal and Prize]] of the [[German Physical Society]] for his contributions to theoretical physics. The award recognized his work on path integrals and gauge field theories in both particle and condensed matter physics.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Preisträgerinnen und Preisträger |url=https://www.dpg-physik.de/auszeichnungen/dpg-preise-mit-anderen-organisationen/max-born-preis-und-medaille/preistraeger |access-date=2026-07-22 |website=DPG |language=en}}</ref>

On the occasion of his 60th birthday in 2001, a [[Festschrift]] titled ''Fluctuating Paths and Fields'' was dedicated to Kleinert.<ref>{{Cite book |title=Fluctuating Paths and Fields: Festschrift Dedicated to Hagen Kleinert on the Occasion of His 60th Birthday |publisher=World Scientific |year=2001 |isbn=978-981-281-124-0 |editor1-last=Janke |editor1-first=Wolfhard |location=Singapore |doi=10.1142/4726 |editor2-last=Pelster |editor2-first=Axel |editor3-last=Schmidt |editor3-first=Hans-Jürgen |editor4-last=Bachmann |editor4-first=Michael}}</ref>
